import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 1000009;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static long powerMod(long a, long b, long mod) {
        long ret = 1;
        long base = a % mod;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) {
                ret = (ret * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int[] dis = new int[N];
        long ans = 1;

        if (k == 0) {
            for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
                ans = (ans * p) % MOD;
            }
            System.out.println(ans);
            sc.close();
            return;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < p; ++i) {
            if (dis[i] != 0) continue;
            int j = i, d = 0;
            do {
                dis[j] = ++d;
                j = (int)((long)j * k % p);
            } while (dis[j] == 0);
            if (powerMod(k, d, p) == 1) {
                ans = (ans * p) % MOD;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
